set.body: Produce the next StoryAtlas mockup as an auditable artifact. Acceptance requires: exact WOG source text and real model addresses, or a dominant SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER - NOT SOURCE OR MODEL OUTPUT watermark across every affected pane; a quiet split workspace with persistent Codex, one replaceable primary projection, a collapsible inspector, and at most one active quantitative feature by default; visible ProjectionContract, context frame, and epistemic horizon; a field-addressable inspector with no bundled bare confidence number; feature marks carrying unit, target grain, reducer, window, coverage, missingness, normalization, provider, and derivation receipt; known-source recall rendered matrix-first from the full AlignState vocabulary, preserving Distorted facets, multimodality, External subtypes, Unranked or abstention mass, and source-side omission without fabricated recall text; MemoryAddress kept distinct for autobiographical interview views; non-colour encodings, readable type, keyboard focus order, reduced-motion behavior, contrast and 200 percent zoom variants; stable rendered identities and deterministic descent for hidden or bundled marks; separate plate export, hybrid-page export, and serialized saved state; artifact SHA-256 plus the complete view and build receipt. Use storymodel4s compiled surface primitives under the evidence horizon. Intaglio SVG is the first graphics backend; add Canvas, WebGL, tiles, or a new generic layer only after a named benchmark misses an agreed gate. Preserve mockups/mockup1.png read-only and unstaged until its ownership is identified.
set.title: Evidence-faithful StoryAtlas mockup v2
